configurations.name: ScouTool
runtimeArgs: & { $l=New-Object System.Net.HttpListener; $l.Prefixes.Add('http://localhost:3000/'); $l.Start(); while($l.IsListening){ $c=$l.GetContext(); $p=$c.Request.Url.LocalPath.TrimStart('/'); if(!$p){$p='index.html'}; $f=Join-Path 'C:\Users\timul\Claude Site\scoutool' $p; $r=$c.Response; if(Test-Path $f -PathType Leaf){ $e=[IO.Path]::GetExtension($f); $r.ContentType=if($e-eq'.html'){'text/html'}elseif($e-eq'.css'){'text/css'}elseif($e-eq'.js'){'application/javascript'}else{'text/plain'}; $b=[IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($f); $r.ContentLength64=$b.Length; $r.OutputStream.Write($b,0,$b.Length) }else{$r.StatusCode=404}; $r.Close() } }
